notes: Read the source line by line (L1-334) before editing. Imports L1-24 are all web/DOM-coupled and were re-homed: React hooks useCallback/useMemo/useState L1 kept; react-i18next useTranslation L2 -> useNativeTranslationFallback() t-shim returning the English fallback verbatim (RoutePlayback/LocationMapWidget precedent); lucide MapPin/Navigation2 L3 -> decorative native glyphs (MapPin \u{1F4CD}, Navigation2 \u{1F9ED}); the Leaflet/maps barrel L4-16 (MapContainer/Polyline/CircleMarker/MapTileLayer/MapInvalidator/MapLayerSwitcher/AnimatedMarker/latLngBounds/useMap + LatLngExpression/MapStyle) -> native projected RouteCanvas (see below); GlassPanel L17 + EmptyState/AlertBanner L18 -> native components (AlertBanner inlined); the geo helpers L19-23 (haversineDistance/hasMeaningfulRoute/firstValidIndex, plus isValidLatLng/MIN_MEANINGFUL_ROUTE_METERS they depend on) ported verbatim from web @/lib/geo; DrivePosition type L24 ported faithfully as a local exported interface (full web shape).

Header docblock L26-36 preserved as the component docstring (controlled map; marker tracks currentIndex exclusively; page above is the single source of truth). TripReplayMapProps L37-49 ported field-for-field: positions, currentIndex, onSeekToIndex, reduceMotion?=false, initialMapStyle?:MapStyle, className?, height?:number|string. The MapStyle union is mirrored locally ('dark'|'satellite'|'streets'|'terrain'); className is retained for source compatibility but ignored on native (destructured _className); height is applied to the panel (web style={{height}}).

speedColor L53-58 ported verbatim (kmh<30 #10b981, <60 #22d3ee, <100 #f59e0b, else #ef4444). computeHeading L60-69 great-circle bearing ported verbatim (toRad/toDeg, dLon, atan2, +360%360). nearestSampleIndex L74-90 ported verbatim and re-exported (length===0 -> 0, linear haversine min scan). The geo dependencies pulled in for hasMeaningfulRoute/firstValidIndex (haversineDistance, isValidLatLng rejecting (0,0)/out-of-range, MIN_MEANINGFUL_ROUTE_METERS=10) are ported verbatim from @/lib/geo so the L144/L145 derivations behave identically.

FitBounds L92-125 (useMap + latLngBounds.fitBounds padding [40,40] / setView zoom 15, with the zero-extent spread>1e-5 guard + single-point/fallbackCenter cases) is browser-only imperative Leaflet control. Replaced by an always-fit lat/lng->0..1 projection (computeBounds/normalize/projectLatLng) so the trail always fills the native canvas — the same visual outcome FitBounds produced (it always framed the route). normalize collapses a zero-span axis to 0.5, covering the single-point/zero-extent fallback. resolveHeight maps number|string height -> DimensionValue (default 450, matching L136).

Component L129-137 destructure + defaults ported exactly (reduceMotion=false, initialMapStyle='dark', height=450). useTranslation L138 -> t-shim; mapStyle state L139 preserved (useState<MapStyle>(initialMapStyle)). hasRoute L144 = hasMeaningfulRoute(positions) and anchorIdx L145 = firstValidIndex(positions) preserved (useMemo). anchorPoint L146-150 is folded into the stationary-anchor render (web centers the map on it; native draws a single centered anchor dot).

trail L154-157 preserved (hasRoute ? positions.map([lat,lng]) : []); a Number.isFinite filter is added for native projection robustness (RoutePlayback precedent) — hasMeaningfulRoute already guarantees >=2 valid points. startPos L158 / endPos L159-160 preserved (endPos only when length>1). centerPos L161 is Leaflet-only (map center) and dropped — the projection self-frames. speedSegments L163-179 preserved as speedSegmentPoints: each consecutive pair becomes a segment coloured by speedColor(curr.speed ?? 0) where curr is the later point; sampled to MAX_TRAIL_SEGMENTS=120 native View vertices.

heading L181-187 ported verbatim (hasRoute && length>=2 guard, next=clamp(currentIndex+1), prev=next-1, computeHeading). currentPosition L189 preserved (hasRoute ? positions[currentIndex] ?? null : null) and projected to markerPos. handlePolylineClick L191-199 (Leaflet polyline click -> nearestSampleIndex -> onSeekToIndex) has no native polyline-click; replaced by a tappable canvas: a tap is un-projected (unprojectLatLng, inverse of projectLatLng) back to lat/lng then fed through the SAME nearestSampleIndex + onSeekToIndex, preserving the map->chart seek channel and the positions.length===0 early return. heightStyle L201 -> resolveHeight.

Render L203-208: GlassPanel with rounded/overflow-hidden + height + data-testid='trip-replay-map' -> native GlassPanel style + testID='trip-replay-map'. positions.length>0 gate L209 preserved. MapContainer L211-220 (center/zoom/scrollWheelZoom/zoomControl + fade/zoom/markerZoom animations = !reduceMotion) -> native MapCanvas; MapTileLayer L221 + MapInvalidator L222 have no native tile analogue and are dropped (a mapStyle-tinted backdrop + grid stand in); FitBounds L223 -> the projection. Speed-coloured Polyline segments L227-234 -> rotated colour-tinted segment Views with the per-segment speedColor; the polyline click handler is carried by the canvas tap layer.

start CircleMarker L236-247 (#10b981 r6) / end CircleMarker L249-260 (#ef4444 r6) -> native Endpoint dots (white/background-bordered). Stationary anchor CircleMarker L262-275 (#22d3ee r8, shown when !hasRoute && anchorPoint) -> a centered Endpoint anchor dot (web centers the map on the anchor, so it sits at canvas center). Playhead L277-298: AnimatedMarker L280-286 (heading + color #00b4d8, when !reduceMotion) and the reduced-motion CircleMarker L287-298 (#00b4d8 r8) are unified into one PlayheadMarker that pulses + shows the rotated ▲ heading when !reduceMotion and snaps to a plain core when reduceMotion (mirrors the web !reduce animation gating). MapLayerSwitcher L300 preserved as a native bottom-left style-chip row (web comment: switcher at the bottom so the top banner doesn't collide).

Stationary banner L303-321: the pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-3 top-3 overlay + AlertBanner variant='info' with Navigation2 icon, title replay.map.stationaryRouteTitle ("Route can't be plotted") and body replay.map.stationaryRouteBody (full GPS copy) -> native bannerWrap (absolute top, box-none) + inlined native AlertBanner (info variant -> accent border/soft bg, accent title, secondary body; all four web variants ported). Both i18n keys + English fallbacks preserved verbatim. EmptyState fallback L323-330 (MapPin icon + replay.map.noPositions 'No position data available for this drive', no-action comment) -> native EmptyState title=\u{1F4CD} glyph + preserved key/copy + the no-action comment. Closing braces L331-334 covered.

Browser-only behaviour documented: an interactive Leaflet tile map / DivIcon / polyline-click event have no native analogue and are reconstructed via a projected View canvas, a tap-to-seek Pressable, and Animated pulse — explicit native-safe equivalents (no DOM/recharts/leaflet/lucide/react-i18next imports remain; RN primitives + Animated/AccessibilityInfo-free prop-driven reduceMotion only). Gates run in apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet`, `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` all pass; only apps/native changes were committed.
